name: Engawa Works
description: A quiet, geometric business theme for a small neighbourhood coworking space in an old timber house with a veranda (engawa) over a courtyard. Pale concrete, soft grey and ink, with a muted ochre used only for rules and registration marks and a deeper ochre for links and buttons. A two-tier header: a slim utility strip with today's opening hours and an Open now / Opens 8:00 / Closed today chip worked out on the server from the site's timezone, the address and a Book a tour link; below it the Geologica wordmark and the menu (on phones the wordmark, the chip and a Menu button on one line). The home page is a bento grid of the space right under a short title: desks, quiet room, veranda, kitchen, events and plans as concrete cards on one hairline grid with ochre corner marks; then a word from the host, the synced membership plans with an editable Most chosen badge and the journal. The footer opens with a slow, pauseable "today at the space" ticker in Fragment Mono (static for reduced motion), then the space details and links. A thin ochre engawa rail with joints divides sections. With The space, Plans, Events, Tour booking (a request form that composes an email), Journal, Newsletter and Contact. Hours, address, phone and email are edited once in Appearance > Space details; the plans are one synced pattern. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: none for the header, footer and layout codes (H9 / F5 / L6 as planned). Colours as planned (concrete #F2F2EF, soft grey #D9D9D3, ink #262624, muted ochre #8A7A4E) plus: deep ochre #655835 for links, buttons' hover, codes, labels and small accents (6.2:1 on concrete, 4.9:1 on soft grey, 6.7:1 on paper), stone #5A5954 for secondary text (6.3:1 on concrete, 4.95:1 on soft grey, 6.7:1 on paper) and paper #FAFAF8 for the chosen plan, chips and form fields. Ink is 13.5:1 on concrete, 10.7:1 on soft grey and 14.5:1 on paper. Muted ochre #8A7A4E is 3.8:1 on concrete and 3.0:1 on soft grey, so it is used only for the engawa rail, registration corner marks, ticker dots, hairline underlines and the badge border, never for text.

fonts.role: wordmark, headings, body text, navigation, plans and buttons
fonts.source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/geologica (variable font pinned to CRSV 0, SHRP 0, slnt 0, weights 300-500, subset to Latin as WOFF2, 22 KB; the same file as Hari Tailor; OFL without a Reserved Font Name)

fonts.role: utility strip hours and chip, the ticker, plan codes, dates, labels
fonts.source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/fragmentmono (Regular; OFL.txt checked: no Reserved Font Name, so subset to Latin as WOFF2, 28 KB from 122 KB)
